picks.name: MIA
picks.bio: Mia Castillo, Miami's "Queen of Bedroom Boogie", after years of sold-out 7"s and touring. "In The Moonlight" (May 29, 2026), produced by Toronto's Gil Masuda, is her debut album on Star Creature.
picks.why_listen: Synth-drenched, intimate funk slappers described as "built for the dancefloor but just as fitting for a night in" -- solid boogie set material with real warmth.

picks.name: Spaced Out Krew & Ghostape
picks.source_note: Star Creature roster mates of MIA (above).
picks.bio: French disco collective Spaced Out Krew (S.O.K.) teaming up with Geneva's Ghostape. "Together / You Make Me Sweat" (July 2, 2026) is a two-sider on Star Creature.
picks.why_listen: Bass-heavy backroom/basement boogie bombs -- described as "cosmonautical freaky mutant funk" with a dangerous twist, good for a set that wants funk with more edge than polish.

picks.name: Carlos Niño & Friends
picks.bio: Already in your library. "Bubble Bath for Giants" (March 20, 2026) is an ode to oceans and nature, self-released digitally on his Bandcamp with a Good Neighbor vinyl pressing.
picks.why_listen: Open, spiritually-minded improvisation in the Iasos/Alice Coltrane/Pharoah Sanders lineage -- not a club tool, but a strong pick for a set's quieter stretch.
